label: DNS
notes: DNS message header per RFC 1035 section 4.1.1 on UDP port 53. All 12 fixed bytes are covered by field views: bytes 2-3 are two bit-packed words, one masked view per flag plus the 4-bit opcode and rcode (the entry has no excluded bytes). AD and CD are the DNSSEC bits of RFC 4035 sections 6.1/6.2; the Z bit is reserved and must be zero per RFC 9619. Response codes above 15 belong to EDNS0 (RFC 6891): the upper bits ride in the OPT pseudo-record's TTL in the additional section, outside this header. The question, answer, authority and additional sections follow byte 12 with variable length (QNAME labels and pointer compression per RFC 1035 section 4.1.4), so nothing past the header is at a fixed offset. DNS over TCP port 53 prepends a 2-byte length word (out of scope for the udp anchor); mDNS on UDP port 5353 uses the same header format but the locator pins 53.

fields.label: Transaction ID
fields.description: 16-bit identifier copied from the query into the response; matching it isolates one request/response exchange (e.g. while investigating cache poisoning).

fields.label: Query Response
fields.description: Top bit of byte 2: 0 query, 1 response.

fields.label: Opcode
fields.description: Four bits of byte 2; Notify is RFC 1996 zone-change notification and Update is RFC 2136 dynamic update (3 unassigned, 6-15 reserved for future use).

fields.label: Authoritative Answer
fields.description: 1 when the responding server is authoritative for the zone.

fields.label: Truncation
fields.description: 1 when the message was truncated; on UDP the client retries over TCP, which shifts the framing off this anchor.

fields.label: Recursion Desired
fields.description: Set in queries to request recursive resolution; copied into the response.

fields.label: Recursion Available
fields.description: Top bit of byte 3, set in responses when the server supports recursive queries.

fields.label: Reserved (Z)
fields.description: Must be zero in every message; a set bit marks a malformed or experimental packet (RFC 9619 retired the old Z bit).

fields.label: Authentic Data
fields.description: Set in responses when the validator considered the data DNSSEC-authentic.

fields.label: Checking Disabled
fields.description: Set in queries to ask the resolver to skip DNSSEC validation.

fields.label: Response Code
fields.description: Low four bits of byte 3 (0-5 per RFC 1035, 6-10 per RFC 2136, 11 per RFC 8490); extended codes 16+ ride in the EDNS0 OPT record's TTL in the additional section.

fields.label: Question Count
fields.description: Number of entries in the question section (1 for ordinary queries).

fields.label: Answer Count
fields.description: Number of resource records in the answer section.

fields.label: Authority Count
fields.description: Number of name-server records in the authority section.

fields.label: Additional Count
fields.description: Number of records in the additional section; 1 typically means the EDNS0 OPT pseudo-record.
